_comment: Expected posts. crosspost_watch.py checks each one AFTER its time passes and shouts on Telegram if it cannot find it. Vizard has NO API to report a failed scheduled post (probed 2026-08-18: publish-record / publish-list / publish-status / scheduled all 404), so this ledger plus a platform-side check is the only way to know.
